name: Heart of Flame
summary: A Heart of Flame is one of the materials Velarok Windblade needs in Searing Gorge. It will help him prepare a torch for an attack on the four sentry towers.

sections.title: For the Torch
sections.body: Velarok Windblade needs four Hearts of Flame and four globes of Golem Oil in Searing Gorge. With these materials, he can craft a torch of flawless flame. He means to set the four sentry towers ablaze and strike before their defenders can react.

faq.q: What is a Heart of Flame for?
faq.answer: Velarok Windblade needs four Hearts of Flame to craft a torch of flawless flame. He plans to use it to set the four sentry towers ablaze.

faq.q: Who wants the Heart of Flame?
faq.answer: Velarok Windblade wants four Hearts of Flame, along with four globes of Golem Oil, for the torch he plans to craft.

faq.q: Where do I find Hearts of Flame?
faq.answer: Golems and elementals in Searing Gorge are the creatures Velarok points you toward for Hearts of Flame.

faq.q: How many Hearts of Flame does Velarok need?
faq.answer: Velarok needs four Hearts of Flame to make the torch of flawless flame.

faq.q: What is the torch of flawless flame for?
faq.answer: Velarok plans to use the torch to set four sentry towers ablaze, creating an opening for an offensive.
